subject: RiskWest: SIG/CAIQ evidence orchestration and subprocessor map
messages:
From: RiskWest Security <sec@riskwest.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@riskwest.com>, RiskWest Procurement <procurement@riskwest.com>
Date: 2025-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ and Subprocessor evidence request for onboarding

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our vendor onboarding checklist we need a SIG/CAIQ responses bundle plus a current subprocessor inventory and evidence for a short security review. Primary asks:

- Completed CAIQ (or SIG Lite) responses where possible.
- CSV export of current subprocessors (name, role, data processed, residency).
- Copy of most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine).
- KMS/residency mapping for keys used in production (high-level).

Could you confirm delivery mechanism (SFTP, Box link, or secure Share) and estimated delivery date? We need to present materials to procurement on 7/25.

Appreciate it —
Jordan Ellis
RiskWest Security
sec@riskwest.com

---
Note: If you prefer a narrow SIG subset, we can accept SIG Lite focused on encryption, key management, and supply-chain controls.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: RiskWest Security <sec@riskwest.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@riskwest.com>, RiskWest Procurement <procurement@riskwest.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-07-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ and Subprocessor evidence request for onboarding

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the list. We can provide everything you requested. High level plan:

1) Deliverables by 7/22: redacted SOC2 Type II, CAIQ responses (PDF), subprocessor CSV export, KMS residency mapping.
2) Transfer method: encrypted Box link (shared with RiskWest SSO + link expiry) or SFTP drop; please confirm preference.
3) Evidence manifest: single JSON index that points to each artifact and the redaction notes.

Ben Carter (cc'd) will bundle the artifacts and handle redaction of the SOC2 report. Laura Bennett will validate the subprocessor residency fields.

If procurement needs DocuSign for an NDA/PIA scoping addendum prior to transfer, let us know — we can expedite.

I will follow up with an internal task list and a link to the secure bundle once ready.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: none in this message

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-07-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Action: RiskWest evidence pack (SIG/CAIQ, SOC2 redaction, subprocessor CSV)

Folks —

Looping you in to coordinate the RiskWest handoff. Summary of work:

- Ben: produce redacted SOC2 (remove customer names + incident timelines per policy), generate CAIQ PDF (we have a draft), assemble evidence files and index.
- Laura: export latest Subprocessors roster from inventory (include columns: provider_name, service_category, data_class, residency, contract_expiry). Pay attention to KMS operators and any third-party logging/telemetry vendors.
- Kimberly: oversee and approve redactions; coordinate transfer method.

Preferred transfer: Box secure folder with link expiry + IP restriction. If RiskWest insists on SFTP, we'll provision a one-time account and rotate keys after transfer. For the Box approach, I'm planning these filenames: Redwood_Subprocessors_20250720.csv, Redwood_CAIQ_responses_v1.pdf, SOC2_Type2_Redacted_2024.pdf, KMS_Residency_Map_202507.xlsx, evidence_manifest_20250720.json

Please:
- Ben, attach the redaction notes (short markdown) to the manifest.
- Laura, include the residency column and flag any on-prem third parties that have EU residency.

Target: bundle uploaded by 7/22 EOD Pacific.

Thanks —
Kim
